items.title: An Indiranagar Morning, Counter to Roaster
items.area: Four stops, all within a 20-minute walk or a short auto ride of each other
items.brief: The neighbourhood has a breakfast for every budget. Start at a tea counter, eat at a darshini, then work up to a roaster, and decide which morning is yours.
items.test: Is the filter coffee at the darshini better or worse than the pour-over at the roaster, and which one would you come back for on a Tuesday?

then.text: An hour with a book at Champaca

items.why: A morning that moves from a tea stall to a roastery tells you more about how this part of the city eats than any single restaurant can.
